items.description: Five nights at Stalin - Point and click First-person action horror, where the player has to be a security guard in a museum of Soviet life.The protagonist gets a job in a museum and on the very first night realises that now his life won't be the same. The museum director calls the hero and tells him that his main goal is not to protect the museum from thefts at all, but to keep an eye on the statue! The director declares that every night the statue of Stalin tries to leave the museum, and that is exactly what you must not allow. You have cameras, a radio, a torch and a table to hide under.You must use the tools given to you correctly to complete your task and prevent your own death.Keep track of Stalin's movements and don't forget to look around.Stalin is a strong opponent who will not just try to escape, but will gradually start to get stronger. Getting fired because of his escape is far from the worst thing that could happen.The game will encounter three opponents, each with their own mechanics, beautifully atmospheric graphics and plenty of detail.There are 5 nights in this game, each more difficult than the last, as well as a hardcore night which is given on full playthrough. This time the action of the game unfolds in the office of an insurance company where you got a job on the night shift as a security guard. From the first day in the office are beginning to happen strange things, Slipper and his friends are trying to attack you, but you still have to work 5 nights, so arm yourself with handy tools and start the game of survival. You'll have a flashlight and a tablet at your disposal that you can use for protection. The tablet will give you access to surveillance cameras throughout the house. Keep track of Floppa's movements and don't forget to recharge your flashlight. There are many memes in the game, as well as an additional mode. items.description: In the distant but surprisingly "leaky" city of Kranovsk, where every house is a maze of old pipes, unpredictable turns and sudden floods, an era of change is coming. A novice plumber decided to learn pipes and become the greatest plumber. Rotate and connect the pipes so that the water gets from the source to the target. Keep an eye on the time, otherwise the water will have time to flood everything around! Turn the sections of pipes so that they create a path for water to the drains, which are marked with yellow tape. Pipes can be either ordinary or angular, cross-by-cross, with the letter T. Keep this in mind when you build your path. You are a beginner with a dream of becoming the best plumber, with a set of rusty keys, a flashlight that flashes at the most inopportune moment ... and a great desire not to flood the neighbors from below.Game Features:Interesting levelsChallenging puzzlesLots of tangled pipesVarious pipesBright and colorful graphics Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame? items.description: Paradise Corner is a cozy and relaxing casual clicker game.After years of wandering, you finally return to your native land. Your garden, once lush and blooming, is now overgrown with weeds, the beds are bare, and pests roam every corner.But with your return, everything will change! A young man greets you at the door – a faithful helper who has held onto hope for your return all these years and carefully tended to what could still be saved. With his support and your determination, the journey to reviving the garden begins.Your task is to gradually, step by step, restore life and beauty to the garden. Destroy pests by clicking on them to protect the seedlings and allow future harvests to flourish without threat. Uproot the weeds, making room for new plantings and allowing the garden to bloom once again. Plant a variety of crops and eventually restore your garden's grandeur, filling it with vibrant flowers and a bountiful harvest!
